```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("../../../../core/framework/R/framework_init.R")
```

```{r load-gazetteer, include=FALSE}
gaz <- jsonlite::fromJSON("dagestan_settlements.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)

fmt_pop <- function(v) {
  if (is.null(v) || is.na(v)) return("-")
  val <- as.numeric(v)
  if (val >= 1000) {
    paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.1f", val / 1000)), "k")
  } else {
    as.character(round(val))
  }
}

fmt_yr <- function(y) {
  yi <- as.integer(y)
  if (yi < 0) paste0(abs(yi), "BC") else paste0(yi, "AD")
}

get_span <- function(s) {
  yrs <- as.integer(names(s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return("-")
  if (min(yrs) == max(yrs)) return(fmt_yr(min(yrs)))
  paste0(fmt_yr(min(yrs)), " - ", fmt_yr(max(yrs)))
}

get_pop_yr <- function(s, yr) {
  k <- as.character(as.integer(yr))
  if (!is.null(s$population[[k]])) return(fmt_pop(s$population[[k]]))
  return("-")
}

get_pop_window <- function(s, yr_vec) {
  for (y in yr_vec) {
    k <- as.character(as.integer(y))
    if (!is.null(s$population[[k]])) return(fmt_pop(s$population[[k]]))
  }
  return("-")
}

get_peak_str <- function(s) {
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(s$population))
  yrs <- as.integer(names(s$population))
  idx <- which.max(vals)
  paste0(fmt_pop(vals[idx]), " (", fmt_yr(yrs[idx]), ")")
}
```

# Introduction

This supplementary report presents the settlement population gazetteer (`dagestan_settlements.json`) accompanying the regional literature review of Dagestan (10000BC - 1900AD). The JSON file follows the standard `population_Stadester` format, indexing `r length(gaz)` settlements across the Republic of Dagestan by `<Name>-Russia` with alternate and Cyrillic names (`other_names`), decimal coordinates (`coords`), and chronological population estimates (`population`) for inhabited benchmark years.

Prehistoric, Bronze Age, and Classical estimates are derived from excavated settlement areas and dwelling counts [@amirkhanov1987chokh; @gadzhiev1991early; @gadzhiev1997velikent; @abakarov1993atlas; @kudryavtsev1982derbent; @magomedov1983khazar]. Medieval and early modern figures draw on epigraphic chronicles, *Posolskiy Prikaz* embassies, and *jamaat* household lists [@minorsky1958bab; @umakhanov1973mutual; @aliev1975feudal; @aglarov1988jamaat; @aliev1999], while 19th-century and 1897 figures come from the 1886 family lists (*posemeynye spiski*) and the First All-Russian Imperial Census [@kozubsky1895; @kozubsky1901; @troynitskiy1905dagestan; @kabuzan1996].

# Master Settlement Directory

```{r tab-master, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
df_master <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(gaz, function(s) s$name, character(1)),
  Other_Names = vapply(gaz, function(s) paste(s$other_names, collapse = ", "), character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(gaz, function(s) {
    paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[1]])), "N, ", gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[2]])), "E")
  }, character(1)),
  Span = vapply(gaz, get_span, character(1)),
  Peak = vapply(gaz, get_peak_str, character(1)),
  AD1897 = vapply(gaz, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1897), character(1)),
  AD1900 = vapply(gaz, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1900), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  df_master,
  list(
    caption = "Master directory of all settlements in dagestan_settlements.json (10000BC - 1900AD).",
    label = "tab:dagestan-master-gazetteer",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Historical / Native Names", "Coords", "Documented Span", "Peak Population", "1897AD", "1900AD"),
    alignment = c("l", "l", "l", "l", "r", "r", "r"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    placement = "!htbp"
  )
)
```

# Prehistoric, Bronze Age, and Classical Settlements (8000BC - 400AD)

```{r tab-prehistoric, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
pre_s <- Filter(function(s) any(as.integer(names(s$population)) <= 400), gaz)

df_pre <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(pre_s, function(s) s$name, character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(pre_s, function(s) {
    paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[1]])), "N, ", gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[2]])), "E")
  }, character(1)),
  BC8000_6000 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(-8000, -6000)), character(1)),
  BC4000_3500 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(-4000, -3500)), character(1)),
  BC3000_2000 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(-3000, -2500, -2000)), character(1)),
  BC1500_1000 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(-1500, -1000)), character(1)),
  BC500_AD1 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(-500, 1)), character(1)),
  AD300_400 = vapply(pre_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(300, 400)), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  df_pre,
  list(
    caption = "Prehistoric, Bronze Age, Iron Age, and Classical settlement populations in Dagestan (8000BC - 400AD).",
    label = "tab:dagestan-prehistoric-settlements",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Coords", "8000/6000BC", "4000/3500BC", "3000-2000BC", "1500/1000BC", "500BC / 1AD", "300/400AD"),
    alignment = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    placement = "!htbp"
  )
)
```

# Medieval and Early Modern Settlements (600 - 1700AD)

```{r tab-medieval, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
med_s <- Filter(function(s) {
  yrs <- as.integer(names(s$population))
  any(yrs >= 600 & yrs <= 1700)
}, gaz)

df_med <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(med_s, function(s) s$name, character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(med_s, function(s) {
    paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[1]])), "N, ", gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", s$coords[[2]])), "E")
  }, character(1)),
  AD600 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(600, 700)), character(1)),
  AD800 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 800), character(1)),
  AD1000 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1000), character(1)),
  AD1200 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1200), character(1)),
  AD1400 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1400), character(1)),
  AD1600 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_window(s, c(1550, 1600, 1650)), character(1)),
  AD1700 = vapply(med_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1700), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  df_med,
  list(
    caption = "Medieval and early modern settlement populations in Dagestan (600 - 1700AD).",
    label = "tab:dagestan-medieval-settlements",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Coords", "600/700AD", "800AD", "1000AD", "1200AD", "1400AD", "1600AD", "1700AD"),
    alignment = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    placement = "!htbp"
  )
)
```

# Eighteenth and Nineteenth-Century Settlements (1700 - 1900AD)

```{r tab-modern, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
mod_s <- Filter(function(s) any(as.integer(names(s$population)) >= 1700), gaz)

df_mod <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(mod_s, function(s) s$name, character(1)),
  Other_Names = vapply(mod_s, function(s) paste(s$other_names, collapse = ", "), character(1)),
  AD1700 = vapply(mod_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1700), character(1)),
  AD1750 = vapply(mod_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1750), character(1)),
  AD1800 = vapply(mod_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1800), character(1)),
  AD1850 = vapply(mod_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1850), character(1)),
  AD1897 = vapply(mod_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1897), character(1)),
  AD1900 = vapply(mod_s, function(s) get_pop_yr(s, 1900), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  df_mod,
  list(
    caption = "Eighteenth and nineteenth-century settlement populations in Dagestan (1700 - 1900AD).",
    label = "tab:dagestan-modern-settlements",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Historical / Native Names", "1700AD", "1750AD", "1800AD", "1850AD", "1897AD", "1900AD"),
    alignment = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE,
    placement = "!htbp"
  )
)
```
